note: ADR 1204: a read after an evaluation that visibly may throw (a throwing getter Get, a `throw`, a local thrower, through an IIFE in a reaction). Chrome is silent at the reads of HandedThrows, DirectThrows, ConditionalThrow, LocalThrows and ReactionLayer, and warns STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at CaughtGetter and DataMember (the twins that stay violations).
